name: tap-bucket-location
body: The Homebrew tap and Scoop bucket are hosted in the public source repo `really-knows-ai/kalide` itself: `Formula/` holds the Homebrew formula `Formula/kalide.rb` (no helper/strategy files) and `bucket/` holds the Scoop manifest `bucket/kalide.json` (plus `bucket/README.md`), so `brew tap really-knows-ai/kalide https://github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide` and `scoop bucket add kalide https://github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide` work anonymously over HTTPS. No separate tap/bucket repos. AC: both commands succeed against the repo's public HTTPS URL for a user with no GitHub account or credentials.
